contract_rule_ledger.quote: Use the original seven criteria and their exact maximum10points; score each independently with answer quotes and verified source spans.
Preserve factual points separately from core citation validity and critical contradictions. Success remains>=8, fullC1-C3, valid supporting core citations, zero critical contradictions.
Equivalent technical explanations and supporting source spans are accepted. Do not require a particular heading, phrase, search route or tool.
Compound claims require their causal parts; mere related keywords are not enough. Verify every cited core span against the frozen source.

For C6, apply the stated member-WAL lifecycle invariant and handling-errors clause symmetrically: answer must attach/reopen the existing WAL (or prove an equivalent lifecycle), and indicate that failure cannot be silently treated as successful recovery. Error propagation/checking wording need not be exact. Record a separate sensitivity point if the minimal-lifecycle-only reading of full_credit would differ, without replacing the primary score.
For C7, require a fresh reopen after optimize without extra writes and known-document checks, with the stated no-crash or already-flushed control. Same-handle checks alone are insufficient.
Never infer missing final-answer coverage from the solver trajectory. Do not repair answers while judging.
Return every criterion, citation verdict, unsupported claims/contradictions, primarytotal, success and any separately marked sensitivity. No benefit conclusions from blinded grading.

critical_contradictions_unchanged: Claims WAL replay itself failed and documents never existed after initial reopen.
Claims optimize never invokes a flush path.
Claims simply calling flush() on this recovered state repairs the lifecycle without further changes.
Claims vector similarity/quantization or Python garbage collection is the causal defect.
Claims same-handle statistics prove disk durability.

citation_policy_unchanged.evidence_sets: All spans in one listed set establish the claim; equivalent supporting source spans accepted by blinded human audit.
citation_policy_unchanged.score_without_evidence: Report factual score separately if useful, but source-grounded success requires verified evidence for C1-C3.
citation_policy_unchanged.retrieval_only_metrics: Optional span/evidence coverage is diagnostic and never substituted for e2e QA correctness.

interpretation_boundaries: C1-C3 factual full credit and actual answer-owned supporting core citations are separate requirements. Reviewer-added spans below cannot supply an omitted explanation or missing citation.

C1 has two causal parts, recovered memory/doc IDs and local/member distinction; C2 requires exact OR guard, null-member arm here and skipped persistence/finalization; C3 connects the call chain to removed old writing metadata and persisted version/reopen consequence. Preserve the original partial-credit rules.
C4-C7 are original one-point compound criteria with no fractional partial point. Do not turn related keywords into a completed causal explanation.

C6 explicitly requires existing-WAL member attachment/reopen or a proven equivalent lifecycle and error handling that does not silently count failure as recovery success. Error wording need not match. The contract permits only separately labeled minimal-lifecycle sensitivity, never replacement of the primary score.

C7 requires known-document checks after initial recovery, optimize without intervening writes, fresh post-optimize reopen, count plus known-document/vector verification and a no-crash or already-flushed control. No test execution is required.

Critical contradiction requires an actual affirmative incompatible claim; absence or insufficient explanation is an omission, not automatically a contradiction. Evaluate only the five original critical-contradiction categories.
Rubric evidence annotations are hypotheses to verify against frozen bytes, not independent factual authority. A locator range being real/in bounds does not establish semantic support.

Do not infer workload/index configuration beyond the question, add reviewer source context to an answer, resolve ambiguous citations in the most favorable way, or promote whole-file overlap into core support.
